URL: https://www.moneysavingexpert.com/news/2026/05/mileage-allowance-increase-chancellor-martin-lewis/
TITLE: Mileage allowance rise 'really important change' for drivers says Martin Lewis
PUBLISHED: 2026-05-21
SOURCE: MoneySavingExpert

KEY:
- Reeves confirmed in Commons today: tax-free mileage rate increased 10p
- New rate: 55p per mile (up from 45p)
- Backdated to April 2026 (2026-27 tax year)
- Average driver doing under threshold benefits ~£120 per year (Birmingham Mail)
- Martin Lewis described it as a "really important change" for drivers

BIRMINGHAM MAIL DETAIL:
- 10p per mile increase confirmed for 2026-27 tax year
- "On average" benefit calculated at £120
- Companies may choose to pay employees more, subject to tax above threshold
- Additional 5p/mile claimable for each passenger transported

CONTEXT:
- First raise in 15 years — Osborne raised 40p → 45p
- Combined with Wednesday's fuel duty 5p cut extension through end of 2026
- Combined with 12-month vehicle excise duty holiday for haulage industry
- Total cost-of-living package ~£400m (Wednesday's fuel duty/haulier component)
- Reeves's broader announcement today includes: VAT cut on summer attractions, child bus travel free over summer holiday, 100 food items tariff-free, £120m ceramics package
